title: Characterization of tree AC
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ belongs to the union of the tree-circuit classes over all natural-number depth exponents if and only if there is a natural number $i$ and a family of Boolean circuit trees recognizing exactly $L$ whose size is polynomial in the input length and whose depth is bounded by a polynomial in $\log n+1$ of degree $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
